Hi! Feel free to get in touch — lisa@lisamayceramics.com.

The best way to reach me about a purchase is email; see [Available](available.html) for how that works.

## Commissions

I love making things for people. If you have an idea, tell me about it and let's talk.

And if you see something in the [gallery](index.html) that's already found a home, don't be shy — my pieces are one of a kind, but I'm happy to make another one in that spirit.
